headline: China’s producer inflation rises while consumer prices cool
summary: China’s October producer-price index rose 5.7% from a year earlier, while consumer prices increased 0.7%, Reuters reports from official statistics. The figures show a widening gap between factory cost pressures and household demand.

sourceExcerpt: BEIJING, Nov 9 (Reuters) - China's producer inflation accelerated to its fastest pace in nearly 4-1/2 years ‌while consumer inflation cooled in October, data showed on Monday, reflecting persistent cost pressures from higher oil prices despite weak domestic demand.

headline: RBA’s Hunter cautions on AI productivity claims and financial risks
